$comment: PTS baseline manifest (owner decision 2026-09-18). Machine-readable facts about each template that the Graph export cannot carry: persona, interference (low|known|high), blast_radius (the soak checklist in words), depends_on (layer ids below), soak (day|week|hold|none), enable_step (doc 05 §C4), report_only_capable (false for continuous access evaluation), client_gate (rows apply only where the client declares the gate). Templates are untouched; SIGIL's seeder reads this into baseline_policies (labels tokens, deploy_phase, sequencing_note). Tiers under rule H: low soaks one business day, known a week, hold until every depends_on layer reads present, none deploys Off until its step.

layers.intune-mdm-windows: Intune device management, Windows (the compliance signal)

CA000-Global-IdentityProtection-AnyApp-A.blast_radius: users who never registered MFA become lockouts, not prompts; Directory Synchronization Accounts stay excluded

CA001-Global-AttackSurfaceReduction-AnyA.blast_radius: travellers and offshore staff; handled per trip by doc 10 Decision 5 (CIPP Vacation Mode on CA001 + CIPP Travel Policy + Huntress Expected rule), never by widening ALLOWED COUNTRIES

CA002-Global-IdentityProtection-AnyApp-A.blast_radius: scanners, copiers and line-of-business apps on legacy protocols

CA003-Global-BaseProtection-RegisterOrJo.blast_radius: device register/join prompts for MFA; shared-device accounts are excluded

CA004-Global-IdentityProtection-AnyApp-A.blast_radius: blocks device code flow, which Teams Android devices use for remote sign-in; shared-device accounts are excluded

CA005-Global-DataProtection-Office365-iO.blast_radius: native iOS Mail and Gmail/Samsung Mail users lose work mail the moment it enforces

CA006-Global-DataProtection-Office365-An.blast_radius: unmanaged browser sessions to Office 365 are restricted; users on personal browsers notice

CA006-Global-DataProtection-Office365-iO.blast_radius: every mobile user without the managed apps and Authenticator is blocked

CA100-Admins-IdentityProtection-AdminPor.blast_radius: admins are prompted for MFA at the admin portals; expected

CA101-Admins-IdentityProtection-AnyApp-A.blast_radius: admins are prompted for MFA everywhere; expected

CA102-Admins-IdentityProtection-AllApps-.blast_radius: admins re-authenticate at the configured frequency

CA103-Admins-IdentityProtection-AllApps-.blast_radius: admin browser sessions no longer persist

CA104-Admins-IdentityProtection-AllApps-.blast_radius: revocations reach live admin sessions; no report-only mode exists, deploy Off

CA105-Admins-IdentityProtection-AnyApp-A.blast_radius: admins without a registered FIDO2 key or passkey are blocked

CA200-Internals-IdentityProtection-AnyAp.blast_radius: internal users who never registered MFA

CA202-Internals-IdentityProtection-AllAp.blast_radius: every internal user on an unmanaged Windows or Mac re-authenticates constantly until the device layer exists

CA203-Internals-AppProtection-MicrosoftI.blast_radius: Intune enrollment asks for MFA; expected

CA204-Internals-AttackSurfaceReduction-A.blast_radius: unknown-platform sign-ins are the point; supported platforms are untouched

CA205-Internals-BaseProtection-AnyApp-Wi.blast_radius: every Windows user whose device is not enrolled or not compliant is blocked

CA206-Internals-IdentityProtection-AllAp.blast_radius: internal browser sessions no longer persist

CA207-Internals-AttackSurfaceReduction-S.blast_radius: the selected apps are blocked for internals; confirm the app list against real use

CA208-Internals-BaseProtection-AnyApp-Ma.blast_radius: every Mac user whose device is not enrolled or not compliant is blocked

CA209-Internals-IdentityProtection-AllAp.blast_radius: revocations reach live internal sessions; no report-only mode exists, deploy Off

CA300-ServiceAccounts-IdentityProtection.blast_radius: non-human sign-ins that cannot answer MFA; confirm each service account's real sign-in path first

CA301-ServiceAccounts-AttackSurfaceReduc.blast_radius: service accounts signing in from outside ALLOWED COUNTRIES - SERVICE ACCOUNTS

CA400-GuestUsers-IdentityProtection-AnyA.blast_radius: guests are prompted for MFA; expected

CA401-GuestUsers-AttackSurfaceReduction-.blast_radius: guests lose access to apps outside the allowed set; confirm which apps guests actually need

CA402-GuestUsers-IdentityProtection-AllA.blast_radius: guests re-authenticate at the configured frequency

CA403-GuestUsers-IdentityProtection-AllA.blast_radius: guest browser sessions no longer persist

CA404-GuestUsers-AttackSurfaceReduction-.blast_radius: the selected apps are blocked for guests; confirm the app list

CA500-SharedDevices-BaseProtection-AnyAp.blast_radius: a shared-device account signing in from any device not stamped PTS-SharedDevice, including an unregistered one, is blocked; stamp every board and kiosk before enabling

CA501-SharedDevices-BaseProtection-AnyAp.blast_radius: every shared device that is not Intune-enrolled and compliant is blocked
